The /organizations/support/tickets/read API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

SupportTicketMessagesResponse Model - Response from reading a support ticket.
messages SupportTicketMessage Array
Messages of the ticket.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
Example 
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "message": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "profile": "string",
      "time": "September 29, 2026 - 18:00",
      "myself": true
    }
  ],
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ]
}
SupportTicketMessage Model - A message in a support ticket.
message string
HTML body of the message.
name string
Name of the author.
profile string
URL of the profile image of the author.
time string
example: September 29, 2026 - 18:00
Time the message was sent.
myself boolean
True if you wrote the message.
Example 
{
  "message": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "profile": "string",
  "time": "September 29, 2026 - 18:00",
  "myself": true
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
